steps: Pull daily orders for 2024-03-14 and compare against the prior 7 days and the same weekday in earlier weeks to confirm the size of the drop.

steps.name: investigate
steps.title: Finished investigating
steps.detail: The 43% drop is a checkout-service failure, not a traffic loss or a payment-provider problem. Cause type: **bad_deploy**. Sessions and checkout starts were normal on 2024-03-14, but payment attempts fell from about 18,000 to 10,200 and orders fell to 9,908 (conversion 8.4% to 4.7%). steps.title: Rank hypotheses
steps.detail: checkout-service v4.19.1 release broke place-order across all markets

output.summary: Orders fell 42.8% on 2024-03-14 against the same-weekday baseline, with the drop spread evenly across all regions, platforms and channels. The timing matches the checkout-service v4.19.1 release, and an issue report ties that release to HTTP 500 errors on place-order, so the most likely cause is a bad deploy.

causes.title: checkout-service v4.19.1 release broke place-order across all markets

claims.text: Orders on 2024-03-14 were 9908, down 42.8% from the same-weekday baseline of about 17320.
The drop was similar in every region, platform and channel, with no single slice standing out.
Checkout-service v4.19.1 was released on 2024-03-14 and enabled a new address normalizer for all orders.
An issue reports that place-order returns HTTP 500 since v4.19.1, with the POST /orders error rate rising from under 1% to roughly 44% across all regions and platforms.
Payment attempts fell from about 18,000 to 10,209 on 2024-03-14 while the payment failure rate stayed near 2.9%, so the loss happened before payment rather than at the provider.

CHG-0035.title: checkout-service v4.19.1
CHG-0035.body: Enable new address normalizer for all orders. Clean up feature flags from last quarter.

ISS-0025.title: Place order returns HTTP 500 since checkout-service v4.19.1
ISS-0025.body: After the v4.19.1 rollout the place-order endpoint fails for a large share of carts. Error rate on POST /orders went from under 1% to roughly 44%. Stack trace points at the new validation code. Affects all regions and platforms. Rollback under discussion.
